newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviews RWE's RSB/Russia's Tenex nuclear deal.
newsitem.headline: EU reviews RWE's RSB/Russia's Tenex nuclear deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was starting a routine probe into a joint venture between Russian state-controlled AO Techsnabexport (Tenex) and RSB Logistic Projektspedition GmbH, which is ultimately controlled by German energy group RWE.

Under the terms of the deal, RSB and Tenex will take joint control of Fuel Logistic GmbH by way of purchase of shares in a newly created joint company, the Commission said in a notice to be published in the EU's Official Journal.
Fuel Logistic provides services including transport for products used in the nuclear industry mainly in trade with Russia, the notice said.
Tenex exports metals, uranium-containing substances and other non-military nuclear products, it added.
The Commission said the deal was submitted to it for clearance on February 26 under the European Union's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
It has about a month from that date to clear the operation or start an in-depth probe if it is worried about fair competition in the Union. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
